[vc_row][vc_column][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Placement"]

The academic excellence of Department of Civil Engineering (CE) is reflected in its student’s exemplary record in placements in the corporate and engineering sectors. The Department has consistently maintained an excellent recruitment record. Civil Engineering graduates are recruited by some of the leading corporates like SKILLTECH ENGINEERS & CONTRACTORS, SOBHA DEVELOPERS, CADD CENTRE, SEVENTH SENSE, CIVIL TECH, ROOT DESIGN ENGINEERS etc. Students are given training in soft skills, personality development and how to face interviews. Students often graduate with more than one offer and are given an additional ‘dream option’ to choose the company of their choice.

[/eikra-vc-text-title][/vc_column][/vc_row]
